x: John Stow showed that he was recovering the form that makes him one of our brightest junior stars, with a good clocking on the first stage for the "A" team, and it was nice to see Derek Crooks turning out for us again.

As more of our runners move into the veteran class, with Pat O'Connor entering the ranks in July 1979, Alan Black in September 1979 and Derek Crooks in early 1980, we welcome the advance of our younger runners on whose shoulders the future depends.

His first official role in the Club was as Road Running Captain from 1964 to 1967, a period when our senior teams were the scourge of the road, when he then took over from Derek Crooks as Road Secretary.
